# Fractal_Scaling

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property where network metrics (e.g., degree distribution, clustering) repeat at different scales, following a power-law relationship. Guides the design of self-similar topologies that maintain performance and robustness across varying network sizes in iNEST deployments.
